{"title":"6-week plan to make 5 real friends in Austin (board games, hiking, indie music)","content":"### Strategy (friendship funnel)
To reliably get to **5 genuine friendships**, we’ll build a repeatable pipeline:
1) **High-quality repeated exposure** (recurring groups/events that meet weekly/biweekly)
2) **Fast follow-up** (same-day/next-day text + specific invite)
3) **Small-group hangs** (convert 1:many events into 1:1 or 2:2 time)
4) **Consistency** (6-week cadence with tracking so connections don’t fizzle)

### What this plan produces
- A **shortlist of Austin groups/events** (board games, hiking, indie music) optimized for meeting the same people repeatedly
- A set of **online communities** to supplement in-person efforts
- A **weekly schedule** and “conversion playbook” to move from acquaintance → friend
- **Message templates + tracking system** to prevent drop-off (your stated issue with Bumble BFF)

### Success criteria (verifiable)
By week 6: identify **5 people** who meet most of:
- You’ve met **3+ times** (event + 1–2 smaller hangs)
- You have **direct contact** (text/IG/Discord)
- At least **one mutual initiation** (they invite you or proactively check in)
